summary: The published POA qPCR result and the registered RNA-seq result agree on the direction of Gnrh1 expression: both show lower expression in dnFGFR males than controls across housing conditions. The registered log2 fold change was −0.580. This comparison covers one gene. The authors’ RNA-seq tables test housing effects, so transcriptome-wide genotype concordance remains unassessed. [Published Figure 3B](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12037384/#F3)
openIssues: A signed author RNA-seq table for dnFGFR versus control across all 20 PND320 libraries would reopen transcriptome-wide comparison. Figure 3B provides direction but no tabulated qPCR effect size.
The evidence directory is saved locally and excluded from Git tracking. All 60 source-manifest entries passed SHA-256 verification.
